title: Module 11 Interpretation Check
intro: Each item gives you a short research situation. Decide what the evidence supports.

items.q: A study crosses study method (reread, retrieval practice) with test delay (immediate, one week). Rereading is better immediately, and retrieval practice is better after a week. The lines on the graph cross. What does this show?
o: An interaction between study method and delay
Only a main effect of method
Only a main effect of delay
items.why: The effect of method reverses depending on the delay. That is the signature of an interaction.

items.q: Illustrative cell means (n = 10 per cell): reread-immediate 16, reread-week 8, retrieval-immediate 14, retrieval-week 12. What are the marginal means for method?
Using those cell means, what are the marginal means for delay?
With MS within = 15 and df within = 36, SS for delay is 250 with df = 1. What is F for delay?
items.why: MS delay = 250/1 = 250 and F = 250/15 = 16.67. The critical F(1, 36) at .05 is 4.11.

items.q: For the same data, F for method is .67 (ns) while the interaction F is 6.00 (p = .019). What is the best interpretation?
o: Method has no overall effect, but its effect depends on the delay
items.why: The small main effect of method hides opposite effects at the two delays. The interaction is the story.
